description: The 3D Rotation Demo, the example program of Draeden's 1993 tutorial on 3D rotations for VLA, running in your browser.
about: The example program of “Intro To 3d Rotations”, an assembly tutorial Draeden wrote for VLA in 1993, from the tutorial's own package, with its text and source. F1 to F6 and the 1 and 2 keys change its spin, F7 and F8 its distance.
terms: None found: the tutorial, its source and VLA.NFO state none, and VLA's index of its files, 00INDEX.VLA, only says “All of these files should be found on our disro sites, or on the major Internet demo sites.” Rights holders can reach DosKit's owner below.
imageAlt: The 3D Rotation Demo's red cube of dots, running in DosKit
